FY2026 adjusted EPS grew 9% year over year
Growth indicates improved adjusted earnings, though the release excerpt provides no absolute EPS figure or consensus comparison.
The guidance is sensitive to gas prices; the company says this assumption approximates the current NYMEX forward curve.
The planned pro rata distribution is a future restructuring catalyst, but completion remains subject to conditions.
Reserve growth supports the upstream business's production runway; reserves replaced 150% of fiscal 2026 production.
